chapter.verse: Zeisu Jerikho khuapi sungah lut a, khua sung a paisuak lai takin,
Zakkhias kici mi khat a om hi. Amah in siahdongte’ ukpa ahih manin sum a hau hi.
Tua pa in Zeisu bang mi ahi hiam ci-in a mu nuam hi. Ahih hangin a tun’ tom mi ahih ciangin mi a tam luat manin a mu thei kei hi.
A mai lam tai a, Zeisu en dingin theitheek kung khat tungah a kahto hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, tua lampi in Zeisu pai nading lam ahi hi.
Zeisu in tua mun a tun’ ciangin ento a, “Zakkhias aw, a manlangin hong kum in. Tuni-in nangma innah kong taam ding hi,” a ci hi.
Zakkhias kum mengmeng a, nuam mahmahin Topa a tungsak hi.
Tua thu amaute in a muh uh ciangin, “Mawhneipa’ inn sungah a taam hi,” ci-in a zahko uh hi.
Zakkhias ding a, “Topa aw, keimah in ka neihsa kimkhat mizawngte ka pia ding hi. Mi khatpeuh na ka lakkhak leh, a zah li-in ka loh kik ding hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Hih pa in Abraham’ tapa ahih man-inah tuni-in hih inn sungah gupna a tung hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Mihing Tapa in a mangthang mite zong ding leh gum dingin hong pai ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua thu a zak lai takun Jerusalem khuapi tawh kinai tung ta a, Pasian’ Gam a manlangin hong tung ding hi ci-in mite in a up man-unah, thugentehna khat Zeisu in a hilh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in, “Mihau khat in gam dang khatah kumpi za ngah ding leh tua khit ciangin a ciahkik dingin a paikhia hi.
Amah in a nasemte sawm sam a, sum tawi sawm a pia hi. ‘Ka hong tun’ kik matengin summet na bawl un,’ ci-in thu a pia hi.
A gam mite in amah mudah uh a, ‘Hih mi in eite kumpi dingin ka deih kei uh hi,’ ci-in ama kiangah mi a sawl uh hi.
Hausapa in a gam a ngah khit ciangin hong ciahkik a, a sum a kepsak nasemte in sum bawlna pan a met bangzah a ngah uh hiam cih a theih nadingin tuate a samsak hi.
A masa belpa in a topa va nai a, ‘Topa aw, na dangka tawi khat-in tawi sawm a met kingah zo hi,’ a ci hi.
A topa in, ‘Thuman nasempa aw, a pha hi: Nang thu neute tungah diktat na hih maninah khuapi sawm na uk ding hi,’ ci-in a gen hi.
A nihna nasempa in va nai a, ‘Topa aw, na sum tawi khat in tawi nga a met kingah zo hi,’ a ci hi.
Topa in, ‘Nang in khuapi nga na uk in,’ a ci hi.
Adang khat in va nai a, ‘Topa aw, en in. Ka dial ah tunin ka kepsa na sum tawi hiah a om hi.
Nang mi haksa na hi hi. Na koih lohna pan na la hi; na vawh lohna-ah na at ahih maninah kong kihta hi,’ a ci hi.
A topa in, ‘Nasem gilopa aw, nangma kam sung panin thu kong khen ding hi. Keimah in mi haksa ka hi a, ka koih lohna pan ka lak leh ka vawh lohna-ah ka at hi ci-in na thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, kong tun’ kik ciangin dangka teng leh a met ka ngah khop nadingin, sum sinpa kiangah ka sum bang hangin pia lo na hiam?’ a ci hi.
A kianga dingte kiangah, ‘Sum tawi khat hihpa khut sung pan lakhia un la, tawi sawm neipa na pia un,’ ci-in a gen hi.
Amaute in, ‘Topa aw, hihpa in dangka tawi sawm a nei zo hi,’ a ci uh hi.
‘Ke’n kong cih-inah, a neite khempeuh a kipiak beh ding hi. A nei lote kiang pan a neihsa nangawn a kilakhia ding hi.
Tua tham loin kei uk ding a ut lo ka galte hong paipih un la, keima mai-ah na that un,’ ci-in thu a pia hi,” a ci hi.
Tua thu a gen khit ciangin, Zeisu Jerusalem khuapi-ah pai dingin a pai masa hi.
Zeisu in Oliv kici mualah a om Bethfage khua leh Bethani khua a naih ciangin a nungzuite nih sawl a,
“Na mai uh ah a om khua-ah pai un. Tua khua-ah na lut uh ciangin, kuama tuan’ ngei lohna khau kikhihsa a, om lano khat thakhatin na mu ding uh hi. Lano khau sut un la, ka kiangah hong paipih ta un.
Mi khatpeuh in, “Bang hangin lano khau sut na hi uh hiam?” hong cih leh, ‘Topa in a deih hi,’ na ci un,” ci-in a vaikhak hi.
A sawltakte pai uh a, Zeisu cih bangin a mu uh hi.
La khau a sut lai takun la neite in, “Bang hangin khau sut na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dot uh ciangin,
“Topa in a deih hi,” a ci uh hi.
Amaute in lano Zeisu kiangah paipih uh a, a tungah amau puante a phah khit uh ciangin Zeisu a tuangsak uh hi.
Amah a pai lai takin lampi-ah puante a phah uh hi.
Jerusalem khua tawh kinai Oliv Mual tung pan a paisukna mun a tun’ lai takun, a nungzuite khempeuh lungdam uh a, a muhsa uh nalamdangte khempeuh hangin nakpi-in Pasian a phat uh hi.
“Pasian’ min tawh hong pai Kumpipa in thupha ngah ta hen; Vantungah nopna leh, A sang belna-ah minthan’na om ta hen,” ci-in a kiko uh hi.
Mihonpi lakah Farisaite kimkhat in, “Sia aw, na nungzuite na taai in,” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Ke’n kong cih-inah, hih mite a daih uh leh, suangte in a kiko ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in a naih ciangin khuapi mu-in kap a,
“Nang in tu lai taka nopsakna tawh kipawl nate thei lecin nang ading a pha ding hi. Tu-in ahih leh, na mittang pan a kiseel hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, na galte in na kimkot ah kan bawlin hong uumcip a, mun khempeuh panin hong khakcip ding uh hi.

Nang akipan na sunga om na tate leitungah a kipuksak ding ni a hong tung ding a; na sunga suang khat tungah suang kiciang khat beek a omsak kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, Pasian hong hawhna hun na thei kei hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu biakna innpi sungah a lut ciangin sum zuakte hawlkhia a;
“Ka inn in thungetna inn ahi ding hi,” ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh hangin, note in guta buluhte omna na suaksak tazen uh hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in ni simin biakna innpi sungah thu a hilh hi. Ahih hangin siampi liante, laitheite leh miliante in amah thah nading a zong uh hi.
Ahih hangin mite in ama thu ngai-in beel uh ahih ciangin amah thah nading thu a mu zo kei uh hi.
